title: Matrix pushforward of a density
statement: Let $H$ be an $m$-by-$n$ matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $\varphi$ be a probability density on $\mathbb{F}_2^m$. The associated probability density on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ is the pushforward of $\varphi$ under the map sending a row vector $y$ to $yH$.
